about: The Preface of the formulary “Easter Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: It is truly meet and just, right and for our salvation, that at all times we should praise Thee, O Lord, but more gloriously especially on this day, when Christ our Pasch was sacrificed. For He is the true Lamb Who hath taken away the sins of the world; Who by dying hath destroyed our death and by rising again hath restored us to life. And therefore with Angels and Archangels, with Thrones and Dominations, and with all the hosts of the heavenly army, we sing the hymn of Thy glory, evermore saying:
